summary: Recovery generation 2 found the B021 MATERIAL_RETURN audit implementation already durable from generation 1 but lacking a canonical RETURN. No duplicate code mutation was made. Fresh verification against current main confirmed the audit still matches the allocator core: consumed returns are excluded, material outcomes are recognized, the default unconsumed threshold is 3, and the compiler emits GUIDE_INTEGRATOR with RETURNS_UNCONSUMED only after the threshold. Companion continuation checks still bind return consumption to GUIDE_INTEGRATOR and resident E8/SUBMIT_NEXT.

tests.name: b021_threshold_semantics
tests.detail: Executed deterministic semantics: 2 unconsumed does not wake; 3 wakes; consuming one of 3 suppresses wake; 4 with one consumed wakes.

tests.name: mechanical_continuation_companion
tests.detail: Current continuation audit still binds RETURN_WITH_CONSUMER to GUIDE_INTEGRATOR, counted resident RETURN to E8/SUBMIT_NEXT, and retains RETURNS_UNCONSUMED coverage.
